content.value: The parallel resonant inverter delivers a load power of $\mathrm { P } _ { 1 } = 1 \mathrm { k W }$ at a peak sinusoidal load voltage of $\mathrm { V _ { p } } = 1 7 0 \mathrm { V }$ and at resonance. The load resistance is $\mathrm { R } = 1 0 \Omega$ The resonant frequency is $\mathrm { f } _ { \mathrm { 0 } } = 2 0$ kHz. Determine (i) the DC supply input current ${ \mathrm { I } } _ { s } ,$ (ii) the quality factor $\mathsf { Q } _ { \mathsf { p } }$ if it is required to reduce the load power to 250 W by frequency control so that u = 1.25, (iii) the inductor L, and (iv) the capacitor C.
